name: Punishment For Murder
overview: Scripture clearly establishes the sanctity of human life as made in the image of God, mandating the death penalty for the intentional taking of innocent life. From Genesis 9:6, where God requires that one who sheds man's blood shall have their own blood shed, to the explicit commands in Exodus 20:13 and 21:12 forbidding murder and prescribing capital punishment, the Bible consistently demands justice for the murderer. Leviticus 24:17 and Numbers 35:30 further reinforce this principle by affirming that a murderer must be put to death based on the testimony of reliable witnesses, underscoring the seriousness with which God views the crime of murder.
